extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners, PTAB litigants, IP stakeholders, and public commenters on USPTO rulemaking
extracted.subtask_description: Announcing and summarizing a USPTO Notice of Proposed Rulemaking to formalize the Director Review process for decisions in AIA (PTAB) proceedings, including what issues will be considered and procedural effects. Useful for practitioners preparing comments or planning Director Review requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure fair, transparent, and efficient PTAB procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: The USPTO's goal for the rulemaking is to ensure fair, transparent, and efficient procedures throughout the Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quote: 'To advance our goal of ensuring fair, transparent, and efficient procedures throughout the Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB), today we announced a Notice of Proposed Rulemaking (NPRM) on the Director Review process... Formalizing the Director Review process is part of our comprehensive efforts to work with stakeholders to reshape PTAB procedures and strengthen our processes with integrity, transparency and efficiency for the benefit our entire innovation ecosystem.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of issues the Director will consider in Director Review
rubrics_metrics.description: The NPRM proposes guidance on which types of issues the Director will consider when conducting Director Review of PTAB decisions in AIA proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quote: 'The NPRM proposes guidance on the types of issues the Director will consider in Director Review...' (intended to clarify what issues are appropriate for Director Review).

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing and format of Director Review requests
rubrics_metrics.description: The rulemaking would set standards for when and how parties may submit requests for Director Review (timing and formatting requirements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quote: 'The NPRM proposes guidance on ... the timing and format of Director Review requests,' indicating the NPRM will specify procedural timing and submission format expectations for requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director Review on the Director’s own initiative ('sua sponte')
rubrics_metrics.description: The NPRM addresses the circumstances and procedures for the Director to initiate Director Review on his or her own motion (sua sponte).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quote: 'The NPRM proposes guidance on ... as well as Director Review of decisions on the Director’s own initiative (“sua sponte”).' This signals proposed criteria/procedures for sua sponte review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact of Director Review on the underlying AIA proceeding
rubrics_metrics.description: The proposed rule will address how invoking Director Review affects the progress, status, or outcomes of the underlying AIA proceeding before the PTAB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quote: 'The proposed rule further addresses the impact of Director Review on the underlying AIA proceeding,' i.e., whether and how Director Review pauses, alters, or influences the underlying matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing for appeal to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit
rubrics_metrics.description: The NPRM would clarify how Director Review interacts with and affects the timing for filing appeals to the Federal Circuit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quote: 'The proposed rule further addresses ... the timing for appeal to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit,' indicating proposed guidance on when an appeal window opens or is tolled relative to Director Review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegation of Director Review
rubrics_metrics.description: The proposed rule will address delegation—who may perform Director Review or exercise Director Review authority within the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quote: 'The proposed rule further addresses ... the delegation of Director Review,' signaling criteria and rules around delegating review authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director Review as a vehicle to request rehearing of PTAB decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Director Review is identified as a mechanism by which parties can request rehearing of certain PTAB decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quote: 'Director Review has been an important way for parties to request rehearing of certain PTAB decisions.' This frames Director Review's substantive purpose and the types of party actions it supports.
